title: Finite sums preserve convergence in measure
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Finite sums preserve convergence in measure. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: On a finite measure space, take a finite family of sequences of almost-everywhere strongly measurable functions into a seminormed additive commutative group. If each sequence converges in measure to its given limit, the sums converge in measure to the sum of the limits.
